target: lean_center original measured standing rear camera and box armchair back

equations.equilibrium: sum F=[0,0,W]; sum p cross F = COM cross [0,0,W]; full23joint gravity minus fixed-material contact Jacobian torque
equations.contact: Endpoint point = root*FK(body)*constant local material; every body vertex remains nonpenetrating and endpoint point lies on observed plane. Load transfer uses that same material. Marker comes only from the original analytic seed; unloaded backward approach retains exposed-min geometry.
equations.objective: full23joint squared torque / original standing torque + readiness epigraph squared + .05 joint deviation squared + .05 fixed-material tangent error squared / .15^2 + normalized root lowering squared; backward connection adds .1 endpoint-guided posture distance squared + .01 interval seconds
equations.clock: joint command arc/.125; normal joint arc/.05 and .003/.0055 per normal edge; 0.5s explicit quiet reserve plus actual25CURRENT requirement; >=.25s/load edge; 1s settle; complete settled trajectory<14.4s
equations.optimization: SLSQP60iterations per named endpoint/edge,ftol1e-9; success mandatory, equality<=.002 and inequality>=-1e-6; total parent45s cap overrides all stages

resources.timeout_output: process receipt and already written seed/endpoint audit; no salvaged point admission
resources.source_operations: One bounded BFS within existing target mask; precompute original depth cloud once; cached O(1)facet queries per callback; unchanged one full solve60iterations/node and complete audits in45s parent cap. No GPU.

finite_return: Reject unless complete path, fullmesh, between-node feet/normal speed, float32 action bounds/filter/fingers and hold reserve pass; current-input runtime, ankle quiet and actual physical fullrollout gates still separately required.
limitations: Quasi-static model is not realized balance or contact force
ImplicitPD torque proxy is not physical energy
Sampled audit is not continuous geometry proof
Same-pose load transfer is a restriction; failure is not robot impossibility
Raw joint velocity guards remain unchanged
No simulation/PPO autostart on model pass
Exact derivatives may not resolve constrained optimization; failure remains reject, no retry/resume or iteration increase.
A single observed facet can still fail; no alternative facet, retry, continuation, budget or tolerance change. Depth triangulation is not a physical support certificate.
Exact readiness elimination removes only an auxiliary bottleneck; nonsmooth physical camera/contact constraints and feasibility remain unresolved until actual checks pass.
Spatial initialization is not a controller or a physical foot-stability result; no simulation if any original full-path gate fails.

derivatives.FK: Forward chain-rule derivative of original root rotation-vector and joint-axis transforms; full23active joints plus6floatingbase coordinates
derivatives.forces: Differentiate exact full6D equilibrium and both foot force allocations; no force or motor sensor claimed
derivatives.torque: Differentiate all23 gravity and material-fixed contact moments including axes/origins/CoM/force points and forces
derivatives.feet: Original position and rotation-log errors via exact SO3 right Jacobian inverse
derivatives.camera: At every callback recompute actual per-body minimum sample and its observed facet from saved current depth; derivative of selected material point signed plane distance. Row values must match original compressed rows to1e-10. Unknown rows derivative0, no free-space claim. Nonsmooth ties retain a piecewise derivative; no averaging or margin relaxation.
derivatives.prelaunch_synthetic: Independent SciPy rotation and logarithm central differences at zero and nonzero rotations
derivatives.scientific_pre_solve_audit: Central differences of ORIGINAL model at original analytic seed: all23torques,12footerrors,3materialpointcomponents vs exactJac; maximumabsolute<2e-5,scaled<2e-6,objectivegradient<2e-5. These are derivative implementation checks, not changed feasibility tolerances.

readiness_graph.definition: r=max over l in L and j<23 abs((command_j(pose,l)-previous_j)/(.15*14.4)); L=five original loads for endpoint,only0 for a backward unloaded connection.
readiness_graph.equivalence: All other constraints and physical quantities are independent of r. Original lower bound is0 with no upper bound. Objective adds r^2, monotone on r>=0. For every original feasible point objective>=objective(pose,r_graph); every reduced feasible point lifts via r_graph to all original epigraph constraints. Hence the reduced search preserves the original optimum and every physical condition; existence/global optimum is not asserted.
readiness_graph.coordinates: Delete optimizer column29 only:30 remaining coordinates retained bitwise. Full31vector lifted by inserting a maximum of already evaluated finite binary64 original ready values, no repair/clip/nextafter of returned coordinates.
readiness_graph.rows: Delete46readiness rows per constrained load:230endpoint,46connection. Original foot,command,geometry,timing boxes retained. Assert every retained row derivative in column29 is exactly0.
readiness_graph.gradient: Exact chain rule g_reduced=g_retained+g29*dr; dr selected from actual maximizing load/joint/sign. Ties remain piecewise differentiable; no smoothing/tolerance change.
readiness_graph.independent_audit: Finite differences of the reconstructed objective at original input seed; verify original readiness rows nonnegative and retained-row independence. Original full-model derivative/work checks remain.
readiness_graph.return: Solver success mandatory; reconstruct only r; check original full equations and EVERY original inequality, camera/fullmesh/path/float32/runtime gates. No reported success from eliminating a residual alone.
readiness_graph.connection_bias: Backward connection graph uses its exact fixed command bias from connection_context, matching mechanical_rows. Its derivative is zero because this bias is fixed per edge.

spatial_initialization.equations: For side s, E_s(q_leg)=original6D position and rotation-log errors relative to ORIGINAL standing foot anchor. Solve J_s*d=-E_s using the original full-model analytic derivative and verify every step against independent original FK.
spatial_initialization.limits: At most5updates/leg,original-FK max error<=1e-11,total joint correction<=.001rad; original lower+.031/upper-.031 and knee>=.04 preserved. Every step must strictly reduce error. No line search, alternate branch or fallback.
spatial_initialization.scope: Only initialization from current encoders/static hulls/current contact facet. No prior returned state,13/15-root pose drift,force-only repair,simulation foot motion or extra actuator authority. All23joints remain available in subsequent optimizer.
spatial_initialization.contact: Root coordinates and computed pelvis contact point must stay bitwise unchanged. Saved standing anchors never move.
spatial_initialization.derivatives: The previous primitive foot Jacobian audits are retained; each fresh closure step is checked by original FK. All original model/graph derivative audits still precede endpoint solve.
spatial_initialization.resources: Two seed builds in observed-facet association each can use<=10small6x6solves. All source/hash/initialization/solve/fullpath/audit remains within unchanged45s parent cap.

classification: Contact on a connected finite observed back-surface patch
new_mechanism: Replace the arbitrary single-pixel-triangle endpoint restriction with actual facet association at the moving fixed pelvis material point. Its ray must hit the SAME connected component of the original eligible target triangles; no unknown or disconnected region admitted. Geometry and all load forces use that actual facet normal/offset on every callback. After an accepted endpoint freeze its observed facet for backward normal approach.
initialization: Unchanged original current-input analytic pelvis seed and exact-foot closure. No rejected coordinates or selected alternate starting points. Initial observed facet selects one connected component, not one constrained contact pixel.
premise: Prior single-facet endpoint constraints limit tangential movement to one image triangle. The user requests hip/upper-thigh support on a finite rear surface, without specifying this arbitrary pixel. Moving contact across the actually observed connected surface can expose height/angle adjustments that the old triangle excludes; useful feasibility remains unproven.
success_failure: Mandatory original solver success, all4932rows and exact finite-facet membership, full mesh, every path/encoding/physical criterion. Leaving component or a derivative check failure terminates; no fallback or automatic retry.
finite_surface: Traverse edge adjacency only within the preidentified original target mask, bounded by2*(h-1)*(w-1)triangles. Query unique projected pixel triangle for each candidate; no candidate scan, smoothing, nearest-plane assignment or offset adjustment. Missing/unknown/ground/disconnected pixels reject.
derivative_scope: Within each observed triangle normal/offset are constant, so existing exact derivatives apply. Independently audit at the original seed. At edges use the actual selected facet and record facet switches; no smoothness guarantee or optimality claim from nonconvergence.
return_association: Accepted endpoint final facet normal/offset and finite edges are frozen before dense-load/mechanical/fullmesh/backward-path validation. Recompute original standing gap against this final facet. All original camera masks remain unchanged.
